description: Read and write Todoist tasks, projects, sections, labels and comments on app.todoist.com in your current tab. List, create, update, complete, reopen and delete items, manage project archiving and shared labels, and list project collaborators. Uses your own logged-in Todoist session.

tools.name: list_projects
tools.description: List all projects in the Todoist workspace. Returns every project including inbox, personal, and shared projects with their metadata.

tools.name: get_project
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific Todoist project by its ID.

tools.name: create_project
tools.description: Create a new project in Todoist. Only the name is required — all other fields are optional.

tools.name: update_project
tools.description: Update an existing Todoist project. Only the fields provided will be changed.

tools.name: delete_project
tools.description: Permanently delete a Todoist project and all of its tasks. This action cannot be undone.

tools.name: archive_project
tools.description: Archive a Todoist project. Archived projects are hidden from the default view but can be restored later.

tools.name: unarchive_project
tools.description: Restore an archived Todoist project. The project and its tasks become visible again.

tools.name: list_collaborators
tools.description: List all collaborators on a shared project.

tools.name: list_tasks
tools.description: List tasks from Todoist. Optionally filter by project, section, or label.

tools.name: get_task
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific Todoist task by its ID.

tools.name: create_task
tools.description: Create a new task in Todoist. Requires content (title) at minimum. Optionally set project, section, parent, labels, priority, due date, assignee, and duration.

tools.name: update_task
tools.description: Update an existing Todoist task. Only specified fields are changed; omitted fields remain unchanged.

tools.name: close_task
tools.description: Close (complete) a Todoist task by its ID. The task is marked as done.

tools.name: reopen_task
tools.description: Reopen a previously completed Todoist task by its ID.

tools.name: delete_task
tools.description: Permanently delete a Todoist task by its ID. This action cannot be undone.

tools.name: list_sections
tools.description: List sections in a Todoist project. If no project ID is provided, returns sections across all projects.

tools.name: get_section
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific section by its ID.

tools.name: create_section
tools.description: Create a new section in a Todoist project. Sections help organize tasks within a project.

tools.name: update_section
tools.description: Update the name of an existing section.

tools.name: delete_section
tools.description: Permanently delete a section by its ID. Tasks in the section are moved to the parent project.

tools.name: list_comments
tools.description: List comments on a task or project. Provide either task_id or project_id.

tools.name: get_comment
tools.description: Get a specific comment by its ID.

tools.name: create_comment
tools.description: Add a comment to a task or project. Provide either task_id or project_id.

tools.name: update_comment
tools.description: Update the content of an existing comment.

tools.name: delete_comment
tools.description: Permanently delete a comment. This action cannot be undone.

tools.name: list_labels
tools.description: List all personal labels in the Todoist workspace.

tools.name: get_label
tools.description: Get a specific label by its ID.

tools.name: create_label
tools.description: Create a new personal label. Only the name is required.

tools.name: update_label
tools.description: Update an existing label. Only the fields provided will be changed.

tools.name: delete_label
tools.description: Permanently delete a label. This action cannot be undone.

tools.name: list_shared_labels
tools.description: List all shared label names across collaborative projects.

tools.name: rename_shared_label
tools.description: Rename a shared label across all projects that use it.

tools.name: remove_shared_label
tools.description: Remove a shared label from all tasks across collaborative projects.
